messages.text: Keep going. One difficult day does not define your journey.
You don't have to finish everything today. Just take the next step.
Your designation is your role, not your identity.
Deadlines come and go. Keep learning, keep growing.
Raaste mushkil zaroor hain, magar manzil namumkin nahi.
Thak kar rukna alag baat hai, haar maan lena alag.
A slow day is still a day of progress.
Work hard, but don't forget to live beyond your screen.
